## Services
- AC repair: Same-day calls with common parts already on the truck, so many repairs finish fast.
- Heating & furnace repair: Heater and furnace repairs, with the problem and the fix walked through first.
- Full system replacement: Old condensers out, new matched systems in, and the job site cleaned before the crew leaves.
- New installs & ductwork: New HVAC systems and duct updates for homes, with the crew in touch the whole way.
- Commercial & rooftop units: Rooftop package units, commercial duct runs and multi-unit properties.
- Tune-ups & maintenance: Preventative visits that check airflow, filters and the whole system before the heat hits.

## About
Aken's Affordable Air LLC is a heating and air conditioning company in Killeen. Kaniela leads the work, with techs like Steven and Jason, and Siobhan in the office. The crew handles AC and heating repair, full system replacements, new installs, ductwork and commercial rooftop units. Common parts stay in stock, so many repairs finish the same or the next day, and the business is listed as open 24 hours on Google. Customers say Kaniela has driven 100 miles for a full replacement, and the company van took 1st Place, Best Commercial, at the 57th Annual City of Killeen Christmas Parade.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you come out the same day in Killeen?
  A: Often, yes. Reviewers in Killeen describe same-day service calls, and Aken's is listed as open 24 hours on Google.
- Q: Do you keep parts in stock?
  A: Yes. One customer was told elsewhere to wait 5 to 7 business days for parts; Aken's had them in stock and installed them on day two.
- Q: Do you replace whole systems?
  A: Yes. Aken's swaps out condensers and air handlers, updates ductwork and hauls off the old equipment.
- Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
  A: Yes. The crew installs rooftop package units, commercial duct runs and condensers at multi-unit properties.
- Q: Will you travel outside Killeen?
  A: Yes. Aken's covers Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Belton, Temple and nearby towns.
